answer: Staked deposits, slashed on rejection: each agent identity must lock collateral in escrow before receiving work. Verification is layered like a prism splitting light — transport signatures, task receipts, and peer attestations. A newcomer is provisional until those layers cohere into a crystal-clear history; reputation densifies as clear onyx. Failure mode: if an identity fails verification, its stake is slashed and burned, making fake sybils economically irrational. Cheap identities die; costly ones persist.
